This is an academic experimentation run: propose and test a generated cleaning method with test_method using generated code when it adds value, then apply a passing candidate with apply_candidate with an assessment. If the isolated runtime is unavailable or the method fails, explain that result and test builtin catalog methods where appropriate.
metadata.agent1_summary: The dirty_sales_test.csv dataset contains 30 rows across 9 columns with a dataset health score of 90.2%. Primary issues stem from dirty string-formatted numeric fields ('Revenue' and 'MonthlyCost'), string-encoded dates, and text-based boolean values.

evidence.description: Dirty numeric strings (numeric stored as text with symbols/mixed entries)

evidence.recommendation: Apply 4-level waterfall cleaning → convert to float/int

evidence.description: Date/time values stored as plain text (not parsed as datetime)

evidence.detected: ~100% of sampled values match date patterns
evidence.recommendation: Parse with pd.to_datetime() to enable time-series operations

evidence.description: Boolean flag stored as text (Yes/No or True/False as object)

evidence.recommendation: Map to bool dtype: True/False (saves memory, enables logic ops)

cleaning_categories.title: Correct data types and invalid values

report_summary.note: Technical checks do not establish business correctness. Builtin methods run on the host; generated methods require isolated Docker trials.
